description: Paraphrased queries for tasks.json, each written in different words from its target Task(s), and queries unrelated to every Task. Used for the catalog quality check (QR-007: target in the top 5 for at least 90% and in the top 10 for at least 95%; AC-001: target shown among the first 5 matches for at least 90%; AC-004: unrelated query shows no match for at least 90%) and for relevance calibration.
